subjects.summary: Contains static s32 lbl_80430BD0[13] with byte-valued constants 0x26,0xFF,0xE8,0xEF,0x42,0xD6,0x01,0x54,0x14,0xA3,0x80,0xFD,0x6E. Both byte helpers select a value using the previous byte modulo 13. No code in this TU writes the table.

Maps a current byte to its forward transformed value by XORing it with the previous byte and lbl_80430BD0[prev % 13], then applying one of seven bit permutations selected by prev % 7. In the buffer loop the previous byte is the already-transformed predecessor, initially prefix byte data[15].

Applies the inverse of the selected forward byte permutation using the low byte of prev modulo 7, then XORs with the table entry selected by low-byte prev modulo 13 and with prev. In the buffer caller prev and cur carry byte values and this reverses fn_803B2E04.

Rejects null data with -1. Otherwise passes data+16, len-16 and data to hsd_803B2B20, then transforms bytes at indices 16 through len-1 in place through fn_803B2E04 using each preceding already-transformed byte. Returns zero without validating len or a foreign-helper status.

Rejects null data with -1. Seeds chaining from data[15], inversely transforms the payload in place while preserving each original encoded byte for the next step, calls hsd_803B2B20 on the recovered payload into check[16], and compares all 16 check bytes with the unchanged prefix. Returns -1 on first mismatch and zero when all match; failure does not restore the payload.

Defines paired in-place chained byte transforms with a 16-byte prefix used for verification. Forward processing delegates prefix generation to hsd_803B2B20 before transforming payload bytes; inverse processing restores payload bytes before recomputing and comparing that prefix. A private 13-entry table and seven mutually inverse byte permutations implement the chain.
